name: world-countries
description: World Atlas is a comprehensive web application designed to provide detailed insights into countries, states, cities, and population data worldwide. The application allows users to explore demographic trends, geographic information, and various statistics about different regions.

paragraphs: World Atlas is a comprehensive web application designed to provide detailed insights into countries, states, cities, and population data worldwide. The application allows users to explore demographic trends, geographic information, and various statistics about different regions.
features: Browse & filter: Search by country, capital or region; filter by continent, region, subregion, UN membership and coastline; sort by name, population or area; switch between card and list views. Everything is kept in the…
Country Information: Access detailed information about countries, including states and cities.
State Data: View state-level data, including population counts and city details.
City Insights: Discover cities within states and explore their information.
Population Trends: Analyze historical population data for countries.
